settings.colour_note: Prefer black parts. A black version of the same model at the same or lower landed cost replaces the pick; black options that cost more or change the spec are suggested with reason 'colour'.

fit_limits.notes: GPU length is 435mm without front fans; the two 25mm front fans make it about 410mm. 95mm = card thickness + bottom fan: Jonsbo quotes 117mm from the top slot, but the Mortar's x16 slot may sit one slot lower, so 95mm is used to be safe. PSU 160mm = the ATX front bay (an ATX PSU leaves room for 2×120mm front fans). The top takes a 240 or 360mm radiator. With an AIO there's no air-cooler limit on RAM; kits up to 43mm clear the radiator. Case fans: 3 bottom, 2 front, 1 rear; the top three mounts hold the radiator fans. Air-cooler limit if ever swapped: 172mm.
